column1: # The reach ledger of the slot matrix (doc/claude/SLOT_MATRIX.md § Keeping it honest): every silent-wrong issue filed
# since the release of 2026-11-03, judged against the matrix as it stood on 2026-11-19.
# Columns, tab-separated: issue, verdict, slot, filler, missing, channel, note.
#   verdict  fits-now (the tables hold the slot and the filler) | fits-rows (a row, a type
#            or a prelude helper is missing) | needs-axis (it turns on something the tool
#            does not vary) | outside (not about evaluating an operand)
#   missing  what the tables or the tool lacked for it

column7: The interpreter answers null and the C backend crashes: the scope pass's rescan split the new binding inside each arm of the written-out join. Eleven cells of the gate's sample fail with it and pass with the fix; a twelfth (`r|loop.post:mk:lit|bind:jn.lit.p|bind:lw.x|=co.x`) now answers right and leaks as #2691's `??` tail does.
